notes.title: DISRUPTION Dev Update
notes.content:
DISRUPTION Dev Update

Maker Loadout Example!

Here is a brief intro to the Maker Loadout.

Tools include the Maker Hand, an AI driven construction manipulator that can rapidly build:
[list]
[*] Blast Shields
[*] Barricades
[*] Turrets
[*] Traps
[*] and More!!
[/list]

This device allows for a tower defense aspect to the game play.

[previewyoutube=8_a5aTVRaAs;full][/previewyoutube]
